newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - OLS buys some Fletcher Asia assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - OLS buys some Fletcher Asia assets.

text.p: OLS Asia Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought selected Asian construction interests of Fletcher Challenge Construction Ltd.

OLS, which is based in Hong Kong, said it would take over Fletcher's offices in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia as well as hiring senior Fletcher staff in the region, including regional managing director Graham Duff.
It said the acquisition would expand OLS's project activity south from Hong Kong for the first time, and into the broader South East Asian region.
The purchase price was not disclosed.
OLS said the agreement also involved its acquisition of Fletcher's Hong Kong public works construction licence.

"Because of Fletcher Challenge's previously stated intent to withdraw from construction work in Asia and mainland United States, its activity in these regions has been relatively dormant and no large ongoing contracts are involved in the acquisition by OLS of Fletcher's remaining Asian interests," OLS managing director Alfred Siu said.
"However, OLS has already initiated new discussions with Fletcher's client base in Asia," Siu said.

"The current assets and client network of the Fletcher group in Asia and the retention within OLS of Fletcher's highly experienced core contracting team will substantially broaden the magnitude of project work undertaken by OLS," Siu said.
"To date, this has cumulated to more than A$350 million."
OLS is one of the "China concept" stocks which the Australian Stock Exchange lured to a local listing in recent years as it attempted to raise its regional profile.
OLS described itself as one of the three largest fit-out companies in Hong Kong and China.
